## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Spanish-language 3D first-person game prototype for mobile/tablet, PC, and PS4-style controllers, including a 3D lobby with four team-size modes.

## Requirements
- Keep the game and lobby fully 3D and in Spanish.
- Support mobile touch, PC keyboard/mouse, and gamepad controls.
- PC controls: WASD movement, SPACE jump, right mouse aim, left mouse fire, keys 1–4 select weapons.
- Lobby includes 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4 platforms.

## Decisions
- Implement as a browser-playable Three.js prototype.
- Use locally vendored Three.js modules rather than depending on a CDN.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created Spanish-language UI, lobby modes, controls modal, results screen, HUD, and touch-control markup in `index.html`.
- Added responsive styling for the lobby, HUD, modal, results, and touch controls in `style.css`.
- Added locally vendored Three.js modules under `vendor/`.
- Implemented 3D lobby/platform construction, arena geometry and cover, weapon model, enemy models, and initial combat/gameplay helpers in `game.js`.

### Active
- Complete `game.js`: finish input wiring, lobby selection, combat/respawn, gamepad and touch controls, UI events, and animation/render loop.
- Test app startup, lobby, gameplay, and desktop/mobile controls; fix issues and capture a screenshot.
- Review changes; work remains uncommitted.

### Blocked
- `game.js` is incomplete: input/UI handlers and the animation/render loop are not yet present.

## Next Move
1. Continue `game.js` by implementing input and UI handlers plus the render loop; verify enemy deaths call `enemyDeath()` and respawn state behaves correctly.
2. Run the app and test lobby selection, gameplay, and desktop/mobile controls; capture a screenshot.
3. Review the diff and report verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js lobby, arena, combat, and partially implemented movement/gameplay.
- `index.html`: Spanish UI structure, mode selection, HUD, controls, and touch controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive layout and visual styling.
- `vendor/three.module.js`: Local Three.js module.
- `vendor/three.core.js`: Three.js core dependency.
- `start.sh`: App startup script.
- `README.md`: Project documentation.

## Important Context
- The invalid `$('#').?.();` expression has been removed; gamepad aiming is assigned in `movePlayer()`.
- `game.js` currently ends after `updateLobby()`; event registration and the animation/render loop still need implementation.
- In `shoot()`, enemy health is reduced but no call to `enemyDeath()` is present yet.
- `lastDamageAt` is initialized but not updated in `damagePlayer()`, which affects health regeneration timing.
- Changes remain uncommitted.

## Objective
- Complete a playable Spanish-language 3D first-person game prototype for mobile/tablet, PC, and gamepad, with a 3D lobby offering 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4.

## Requirements
- Keep the game and lobby fully 3D and in Spanish.
- Support mobile touch, PC keyboard/mouse, and gamepad controls.
- PC controls: WASD, SPACE, right mouse to aim, left mouse to fire, keys 1–4 to select weapons.

## Decisions
- Implement as a browser-playable Three.js prototype.
- Use locally vendored Three.js modules rather than depending on a CDN.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the Spanish UI, responsive styling, lobby modes, controls modal, results screen, HUD, and touch-control markup.
- Added local Three.js modules under `vendor/`.
- Implemented 3D lobby and arena construction, weapons, enemies, and core gameplay helpers.
- Added keyboard/mouse, touch, gamepad, UI event handlers, and the animation/render loop in `game.js`.
- Added enemy elimination handling in `shoot()` and updated `lastDamageAt` in `damagePlayer()`.

### Active
- Test startup, lobby mode selection, combat/respawn, and desktop/mobile controls; fix issues and capture a screenshot.
- Review changes; changes remain uncommitted.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the app and verify startup, lobby selection, gameplay, enemy deaths, respawn, and desktop/mobile/gamepad controls.
2. Capture a screenshot and fix any discovered issues.
3. Review the diff and report verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, gameplay, input handlers, UI events, and render loop.
- `index.html`: Spanish UI structure and controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive lobby, HUD, modal, results, and touch-control styling.
- `vendor/`: Locally vendored Three.js modules.
- `start.sh`: App startup script.
- `screenshots/`: Existing screenshots.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Testing and screenshot capture have not yet been performed.

## Objective
- Complete a playable Spanish-language 3D first-person game prototype for mobile/tablet, PC, and gamepad, with a 3D lobby offering 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4.

- Keep the game and lobby fully 3D and in Spanish.
- Support mobile touch, PC keyboard/mouse, and gamepad.
- PC controls: WASD, SPACE, right mouse to aim, left mouse to fire, keys 1–4 to select weapons.

## Decisions
- Implement as a browser-playable Three.js prototype.
- Use locally vendored Three.js modules rather than depending on a CDN.

### Completed
- Built the Spanish UI, responsive styling, lobby modes, controls modal, results screen, HUD, and touch-control markup.
- Added local Three.js modules under `vendor/`.

### Active
- Test startup, lobby mode selection, combat/respawn, desktop/mobile controls; capture a screenshot.
- Review changes; changes remain uncommitted.

### Blocked

- `game.js`: Three.js scene, gameplay, input handlers, UI events, and render loop.
- `index.html`: Spanish UI structure and controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive lobby, HUD, modal, results, and touch-control styling.
- `vendor/`: Locally vendored Three.js modules.
- `start.sh`: App startup script.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture script.
- `screenshots/`: Screenshot directory.

## Objective
- Complete a playable Spanish-language 3D first-person game prototype for mobile/tablet, PC, and gamepad, with a 3D lobby offering 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4.

## Requirements
- Keep the game and lobby fully 3D and in Spanish.
- Support mobile touch, PC keyboard/mouse, and gamepad.
- PC controls: WASD, SPACE, right mouse to aim, left mouse to fire, keys 1–4 to select weapons.

## Decisions
- Implement as a browser-playable Three.js prototype using locally vendored modules.

### Completed
- Built the Spanish UI, responsive styling, lobby modes, controls modal, results screen, HUD, and touch-control markup.
- Implemented 3D lobby and arena, weapons, enemies, gameplay, input handlers, and render loop in `game.js`.
- Added a guarded `capturePointer()` helper around mobile pointer capture calls.
- Added `class="hud"` to the HUD container so its intended overlay styling applies.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Browser diagnostics after the HUD fix show `#exitBtn` is the top element at its screen position; pointer interaction still needs a successful end-to-end test.

- Validate the mobile pointer-capture fix and touch movement/jump/look/shoot.
- Verify desktop controls, lobby exit, enemy damage/respawn, and gamepad controls.
- Review changes and update screenshots if needed.

### Blocked
- Playwright clicking `#exitBtn` timed out with the canvas reported as intercepting pointer events, despite a subsequent `elementsFromPoint()` diagnostic placing `#exitBtn` first.

## Next Move
1. Test `#exitBtn` again after the HUD class change and investigate the inconsistent Playwright hit-testing if needed.
2. Run mobile input checks to confirm the pointer-capture error is gone and touch controls work.
3. Move around in gameplay to trigger enemy attacks; verify death, respawn, and the remaining controls.
4. Review the diff and report verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, gameplay, pointer handling, UI events, and animation loop.
- `index.html`: Spanish UI structure and HUD markup.
- `style.css`: Responsive lobby, HUD, modal, results, and touch-control styling.
- `vendor/`: Locally vendored Three.js modules.
- `screenshots/`: Existing desktop and mobile captures.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed the prototype files as untracked.
- Desktop 4v4 gameplay and mobile 1v1 firing were previously tested; mobile previously logged `Failed to execute 'setPointerCapture' on 'Element': No active pointer with the given id is found.`

- A Playwright test after the HUD markup change reported `#exitBtn` visible but timed out clicking it because the canvas intercepted pointer events; a later hit-test diagnostic placed the button above the canvas.

## Objective
- Complete a playable Spanish-language 3D first-person game prototype for mobile/tablet, PC, and gamepad, with a 3D lobby offering 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4.

## Requirements
- Keep the game and lobby fully 3D and in Spanish.
- Support mobile touch, PC keyboard/mouse, and gamepad.
- PC controls: WASD, SPACE, right mouse to aim, left mouse to fire, keys 1–4 to select weapons.

## Decisions
- Implement as a browser-playable Three.js prototype using locally vendored modules.
- Request pointer lock only after a deliberate canvas click, not on the mode-selection click, so lobby controls remain usable.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the Spanish UI, responsive styling, lobby modes, controls modal, results screen, HUD, touch controls, 3D lobby and arena, weapons, enemies, gameplay, input handlers, and render loop.
- Added `class="hud"` to the HUD container and guarded pointer capture with pointer-ID tracking.
- `node --check game.js` passes.
- Mobile Playwright validation confirmed 1v1 starts, shooting consumes ammo, joystick movement resets on release, look input changes the rendered view, and aim/jump/shoot buttons are visible and can be activated concurrently.
- Desktop Playwright validation confirmed exit returns to the lobby and keys 1–4 select all four weapons.
- Browser console 404 from an earlier run was not reproduced during targeted resource-response inspection.

### Active
- Validate gamepad controls and enemy death/respawn, then review the final diff.

### Blocked
- Enemy death/respawn remains unverified; the latest desktop run did not kill an enemy.
- Standard Playwright locator click on the exit button remains unconfirmed; direct `page.mouse.click()` succeeded and returned to the lobby.

## Next Move
1. Test gamepad movement, aiming, firing, weapon selection, and exit.
2. Engage enemies long enough to verify enemy death/respawn and player death/respawn.
3. Recheck the desktop exit button using a locator click, then inspect the final diff and run syntax checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, gameplay, pointer/touch/gamepad handling, UI events, and render loop.
- `index.html`: Spanish UI structure and HUD markup.
- `style.css`: Responsive lobby, HUD, modal, results, and touch-control styling.
- `vendor/`: Locally vendored Three.js modules.
- `screenshots/`: Existing lobby and gameplay captures.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` lists `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, scripts, `game.js`, `index.html`, `style.css`, and `vendor/` as untracked.
- Most recent mobile test logged `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)`, but a subsequent resource-response check did not reproduce a failing HTTP response.
- Touch multitasking test was synthetic PointerEvent dispatch; prior mobile tests also exercised shooting and joystick movement with Playwright mouse input.
